vercel.classification: actual source/config failure introduced by this branch
vercel.evidence: PR #11 (c0f4067) deployed successfully on the same Vercel project; the failure appeared with this branch
vercel.cause: the chamber imports generated/animation-assets/library-index.json as @chamber/animation-assets, and .vercelignore excluded generated/ wholesale, so the deploy upload was missing a build input
vercel.verification: building a copy of the tree pruned exactly as .vercelignore prunes it fails before the change with the same ENOENT vite reports and succeeds after
vercel.note: no Vercel-side configuration was changed; whether the -api project should build the web bundle at all is external to this repository

knownNonBlockingLimitations: The visual suite starts the real API server and its commit test can rewrite projects/demo-character/project.json; observed once in this pass, restored, and not reproduced on two later runs. git status --short cannot be assumed clean after pnpm harness:visual.
A fatal transaction deliberately keeps the write lock, so nothing in the same process can write afterwards; there is no in-process path to clear a fatal state.
Simulation.rootLocked() still uses the global recovery default when a clip authors none, as recorded in the earlier report.
The plan's subagent orchestration was not followed on the original pass and was not used here either.
